description: Add an optional maxDelayMs parameter to retryDelay(attempt, baseMs = 100). Omitting it must preserve existing results exactly. When supplied it must be a finite nonnegative number; otherwise throw RangeError. Return Math.min(the existing exponential delay, maxDelayMs), including a zero cap. Preserve the existing attempt and baseMs validation and error types. Add focused node:test tests and document the API in README.md. No dependencies, no other API changes, no commit or push. This is a disposable evaluation fixture; keep scope to this contract and use the existing npm test command. Planner output format is mandatory: use the literal headings ## TITLE, ## PRD, ## TASKS, in that order. Put the feature title on the line AFTER ## TITLE; never replace ## TITLE with the title itself. No preamble.
